user.title: Aqara M1S Stock Lab
user.description: Use existing authorized Telnet and stock MQTT access. This integration does not enable access, install a tunnel or modify firmware. Do not connect ZoH/ZHA/Zigbee2MQTT to the stock coordinator UART.

error.invalid_input: Check the host, port and login fields. URLs and control characters are not accepted.

init.title: Stock lab limits
init.description: Only native audio levels 1..5 were physically tested in the .109 lab. Raising the limit allows unvalidated, potentially loud levels. Child switch mappings are protocol-derived, not physically validated; both this option and entity enablement are required. Reconnect does not replay commands.
